## Configuration Tab

The Configuration tab is used to define Meter Configuration data such as the Meter Type, Calculation Method and Atmospheric Pressure.

Similar to Batch Meters, Meter Tickets must also be configured in order for calculations to take place. The Configuration tab on the Ticket Detail screen for Meter Tickets contains all of the same configuration fields that are provided on the Characteristics Meter Tab in the Volume Editor.

For linear meters, if the "Pressure Compensated" option is set to "Yes", the "Meter Factor" label will change to "Comp Meter Factor".



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 609;height: 496;" />

This tab is only available for meter tickets.
